intent: Dark, monochrome three-plan pricing: a billing toggle and three cards that rise from blur, prices counting up on a mechanical odometer, checks drawing row by row, and the recommended plan marked by light and one accent.

stack.animation: motion/react (variants with custom delays, useInView, useMotionValue, useTransform, useVelocity, animate, AnimatePresence, LayoutGroup)

layout.toggle: centred row: radiogroup pill + saving note (stacked below @xl)
layout.plans: stacked; @2xl each card splits price | features with a vertical hairline; @5xl three columns, featured card -16px top and bottom
layout.card: 20px radius, 28/32px padding; featured 36px x 48px y at @5xl

color.accent: #34d399 via the accent prop: featured top hairline, featured label dot, saving pill once annual is on. Nothing else.
color.featured: lifted surface, brighter ring, deep two-stage shadow, ink-at-6% radial light from the top edge

motion.timeline: T object in seconds: toggle 0, cards 0.08 + 0.07 each, then per card head +0.08, price +0.12 (count 0.65s), note +0.18, CTA +0.22, divider +0.26, features +0.30 at 35ms, accent edge +0.42
motion.reveal: rise 12px (cards 20px) from blur(8px), 500ms (cards 650ms), ease [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1]; filter dropped at rest
motion.triggers: toggle row on the section at 15%; each card at 25% of itself; footnotes at 50%
motion.odometer: one motion value per price; counts from 0 on first view, tweens 500ms to each toggled price; units column turns continuously, higher columns move only while the column below rolls 9→0; leading columns fold to 0 width; blur min(2.2, |velocity|/14) px
motion.checks: pathLength 0→1 over 360ms, 60ms after each row lands
motion.toggle: layoutId thumb on spring 500/40; saving pill one 6% pulse when annual
motion.billingNote: in from y 8px + blur 3px (300ms), out to y -8px (200ms ease-in)
motion.pointer: neutral spotlight + edge arc via CSS variables, mouse only
motion.reducedMotion: single 150ms fade, prices set instantly, no blur or transforms

responsive.narrow: stacked cards, toggle and saving stacked, cards land as they scroll in

accessibility: section aria-label "Pricing plans"; each card an article labelled by its plan
billing radiogroup with roving tabindex and arrow keys
visual price aria-hidden; sr-only sentence with price and billing note
footnote markers are links to their note; hover/focus lights both
reduced motion: fades only, numbers set instantly

plans.name: Practice
plans.audience: For small teams with a real payroll

footnotes: Bank feeds via open banking in the UK, EU, US and Canada. Everywhere else, CSV import works fine.
Need more than 40? We’ll price it per book, not per seat. All prices exclude sales tax.

avoid: headline, eyebrow or marketing copy inside the component
emerald glow blobs, tinted featured gradients, gradient text
coloured checks or a hue per plan
per-frame React state for the counting prices
three identical cards: the featured one differs in light and lift
